verdict.rationale: Fern Agent reads the docs source repository and makes changes described in a prompt, can be started from Slack to open PRs, and can run on a schedule to review feedback, unanswered questions and analytics and then open a pull request. Prompt- and schedule-driven work shipped as PRs is covered, but PR-triggered runs and agent review of doc changes are not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of PR-triggered agent runs, agent review of docs or PRs (as opposed to reviewing reader signals), independent or hands-on corroboration.
